readings: Using driver standings linked to their races by race id (leaving out standings with no matching race), for each race name (`races.name`) get the average season-to-date championship points (`driverStandings.points`, ignoring missing values) and how big its standings field is. Then focus on the race names whose field size is strictly above the average field size across all race names. In one row, give the average of their average points, their average field size, and how far above the overall average their field size is on average. No rounding.
queries:
WITH race_name_stats AS (
  SELECT
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) AS average_points,
    COUNT(*) AS field_size
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(field_size) AS average_field_size
  FROM race_name_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(s.average_points) AS average_points,
  AVG(s.field_size) AS average_field_size,
  AVG(s.field_size - o.average_field_size) AS average_excess_field_size
FROM race_name_stats AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE s.field_size > o.average_field_size
